description: This is a Java test class for integration testing the ReadingGoalController in a Spring Boot application. It uses MockMvc to perform HTTP requests and verifies responses for various endpoints related to reading goals, including login, retrieving previous goals, adding goals with validation, and deleting goals.

classes.name: ReadingGoalControllerIntegrationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for integration testing the ReadingGoalController endpoints using MockMvc in a Spring Boot context.

methods.name: canLoginWithTestUser
methods.description: Sets up a test user and retrieves an authorization token before each test.
